NNEW CONCEPT ENGLISHBOOK 01 / 新概念英语

BOOK ONE · LESSON 120

It had already happened. 事情已经发生了。

事情已经发生了。

A picture lesson on the past perfect with 'already', 'just', 'after' and 'before'. Six pictures (s-x) show an earlier completed action (the car had been sold, the train had already left, the housework had been finished before she went out, they had had dinner before they arrived). The written exercises rewrite sentences using 'after' and answer present-perfect and past-perfect questions. The grammar workbook drills combining sentences with 'when' + past perfect, adding 'just' with the past perfect, and making sentences with the past perfect.

120 / 144 LESSONS3 PARTSREAD · WRITE · PRACTISE
01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

听录音并回答问题。

Six pictures (s-x) illustrating the past perfect with 'already', 'after' and 'before'. s: I asked the price of the car, but they had already sold it. t: I ran to the platform quickly, but the train had already left. u: He gave us our exercise books after he had corrected them. v: She went on holiday after she had taken the examination. w: She had finished the housework before she went out. x: We had had dinner before they arrived.

六张图片（s-x）展示过去完成时与 already、after、before 的用法。s 我问了那辆车的价钱，但他们已经把它卖了。t 我迅速跑到月台，但火车已经开走了。u 他批改完作业后把练习本发给了我们。v 她考完试后去度假了。w 她出门前已经把家务做完了。x 他们到来之前我们已经吃过晚饭了。

Listen and answer the questions (pictures s-x)

Listen to the recording and answer the question for each picture (s-x).

听录音并回答每组图片（s-x）的问题。

The recording reads each caption; the answer is the caption sentence itself.
